checkpoint_policy.backtrack_condition: Backtrack when a branch imports a wrong source model, wrong target class, nonuniform leakage, barrier mismatch, or collapsed quantitative threshold.
checkpoint_policy.broad_exploration_pause_condition: Broad exploration is paused until Gap98-SRhNormalForm and the FE_Extract_N/RowSetEnumerator_N fork are proved, refuted, or quarantined with named counterexamples.
checkpoint_policy.current_paper_subgoal_focus: Finalize the required P vs NP proof-delivery results: SR_h normal form, Gamma_bEF line induction, FE_Extract_N, RowSetEnumerator_N, FormulaEval classification, and paper theorem/countermodel handoff.
checkpoint_policy.persist_condition: A branch may continue only when it sharpens source model, target class, reduction, threshold, barrier status, or bridge obligation.
checkpoint_policy.pivot_condition: Pivot after repeated certified failure if another branch protects more target commitments with clearer complexity-theoretic machinery.

branch_specific_queue.stop_condition: Stop or backtrack only if the rule cannot expose occurrence neighborhoods at bit level, if tau/eta are hidden in semantic advice, or if the normal form fails by a named counterexample. Do not broaden into new carriers before this disposition.
branch_specific_queue.task: Finalize Gap98-SRhNormalForm for one explicit bounded-SR_h rule schema: write the verifier bit fields, row-index encodings, touched occurrence-neighborhood list, eta/tau overhead bounds, and line-induction proof that the rule contributes exactly the Gamma_bEF bounded-SR term.

branch_specific_queue.stop_condition: Stop or quarantine if the FormulaEval rule cannot uniformly enumerate RowSet(a), cannot charge N*E_N, or depends on real-SAT semantics without a nonrelativizing certificate.
branch_specific_queue.task: Finalize FE_Extract_N / RowSetEnumerator_N for a concrete transparent Psys_sym fragment: classify FormulaEval-SAT as axiom schema, proof line, extension rule, or semantic oracle; prove N^{1+q+o(1)} expansion for charged cases or finalize the private-row/unread-enable-bit countermodel for oracle cases.

branch_specific_queue.stop_condition: Quarantine support work if it adds MCSP/MKtP or generic barrier material that does not directly refine SR_h normal form, FE_Extract_N, RowSetEnumerator_N, or the paper theorem packet.
branch_specific_queue.task: Support paper readiness only: turn the finalized SR_h and FormulaEval results into theorem statements, proof obligations, non-claims, and a promotion/quarantine decision for the P vs NP transfer-obstruction paper subgoal.

decisive_next_tests: Prove Gap98-SRhNormalForm for a single explicit bounded-SR_h rule schema with bit fields, parent pointers, row-index encodings, local verifier, and eta/tau costs.
Use the SR_h normal form to complete the Gamma_bEF line-induction proof for Psys_bEF^- and state exactly what is now proved versus assumed.

Formalize FE_Extract_N in two columns: row-expanded FormulaEval axiom/proof/extension mechanisms with N*E_N charge, and semantic-oracle mechanisms with the private-row or unread-enable-bit countermodel.

Prove RowSetEnumerator_N for a concrete transparent Psys_sym^sel fragment such as interval-union or AC0 row selectors, or output the smallest selector countermodel showing unavoidable semantic advice.
Compute the exact q/epsilon thresholds for the finalized theorem packet: q<epsilon enumeration falsifier, q=epsilon near-full contact, q>epsilon absolute support pressure with weak density.
Emit paper-ready theorem statements with assumptions, definitions, proof skeletons, non-claims, and explicit promotion/quarantine status.

Emit and validate live pvsnp_inference_quality packets; any result without source statement, target statement, model context, quantifier regime, barrier status, and derivation status is not promotable.
current_certification_focus.next_marathon_mandate: The next 1-hour Azure API marathon must finalize required results for the P vs NP paper subgoal: Gap98-SRhNormalForm, Gamma_bEF line induction, FE_Extract_N, RowSetEnumerator_N, FormulaEval four-way classification, and theorem/countermodel paper handoff. Do not broaden into new carriers, MCSP/MKtP, or generic barriers unless one of these results is formally discharged or refuted with a named counterexample.
non_claims: This is not a proof of P != NP.
This is not a new-carrier search.
This is not a generic barrier survey.
Do not treat semantic FormulaEval-SAT as parsed occurrence support unless FE_Extract_N or RowSetEnumerator_N is actually proved for the chosen fragment.
current_certification_focus.primary_object: Gap98-SRhNormalForm, Gamma_bEF(pi), FE_Extract_N, RowSetEnumerator_N, FormulaEval-SAT four-way classification, and the expansion-vs-private-row countermodel for beta-zero H_N^SAT.
current_certification_focus.promotion_gate: Promotion requires a finished restricted Psys_bEF^- parser theorem or an explicit countermodel, a classified Psys_sym FormulaEval fragment, validated inference-quality packets, and paper-ready statements separating proved theorem, conditional theorem, open lemma, and no-go boundary.
current_certification_focus.smallest_honest_claim: A paper-level transfer-obstruction subresult: restricted bit-explicit lower-bound proof systems either parse into charged Gamma_bEF transcripts that falsify subthreshold LB_N claims, while symbolic FormulaEval mechanisms either pay N*E_N expansion or become semantic-oracle escapes outside the parser theorem.
